name: Resting heart rate variability
rangeNote: Measured at rest, usually overnight or first thing in the morning, which makes it the most comparable HRV value from day to day. In short resting recordings of healthy adults, RMSSD averaged about 42 ms (most between roughly 19 and 75), lower with age. Your own trend matters more than these numbers.
summary: Heart rate variability (RMSSD) measured while resting or asleep. Followed over weeks, it shows recovery, sleep, illness and the effect of habits such as alcohol or training.

high.meaning: Higher than your usual generally means good recovery.

low.meaning: Lower than your usual for several nights often comes with illness, alcohol, stress, poor sleep or overtraining.
